title: Beastmaster: new beasts
description: New beasts for the Beastmaster mod, made with Meshy: the Aurochs (a huge horned wild bull on the game boar's skeleton, it charges). Wild ones appear now and then when Beastmaster is installed; tame one and call it.
notes: The sources are not in the repository: the Meshy glbs and textures, the fitted glbs, the game dumps; the paths below point to a local folder. Build: python -I tools/models/make_mod.py tools/models/packs/beastmaster_beasts.json
The GUIDs are fixed forever: mods/beastmaster/species.lua and players' saves refer to them. The bear has its own pack (beastmaster_bear.json).

Aurochs: Meshy preview 01a17d29-eb7e-76df-bfb0-61b5589e5b22, refine 01a17d34-3937-73cc-8d5f-8c6710102ae2; fitted with blender/fit_to_game_skeleton.py --keep-uvs --keep-head --tail hips onto enemy_wildboar_01 (skeleton d3cb046d, body material 1); a copy of Enemy_Wildbeast_Boar with ScaleComponent 1.3, DamageMod multiplier x1.4, Movement speeds x0.9 (health x3 comes from Beastmaster at runtime).

The aurochs keeps detail bones only where it has that detail (fit_to_game_skeleton.py, clean_detail_weights: its rump is off the boar's tail bones), and its tail follows the hips (--tail hips): the boar's short tail's animation does not drive it.
